description: Epoch AI ai_chip_components dataset — per-chip quarterly component cost medians (HBM/Logic/CoWoS/Auxiliary) for AI accelerators.

body.how_to_read: Filter Designer in [NVIDIA, AMD, Google, Amazon]. Per-component median USD cost columns: 'HBM cost (USD) (median)' = Memory, 'Logic cost (USD) (median)' = Logic, 'CoWoS cost (USD) (median)' = Packaging, 'Auxiliary cost (USD) (median)' = Auxiliary. Sum each component across a designer's chips per Quarter, then divide by 1e9 for USD-billions. Q1 2026 is incomplete (missing NVIDIA) — exclude from history.

methodology.summary: As-downloaded Epoch AI ai_chip_components export (per-chip quarterly cost medians), cleaned only by the epoch_ai ingest (column-name strip, all-null-column drop), copied verbatim into the blob store. Confidence 0.8 = reputable curated third-party dataset under CC BY 4.0; default for migrated source data.
